calls.title: Event Ingestor | Overview
calls.summary: The discussion focused on improving the event ingestion flow with a single lightweight endpoint that enhances scalability, although it lacks deduplication and retry mechanisms, risking data loss. Multi-tenancy is addressed through Kafka topics and Clickhouse materialized views, ensuring strict data isolation. To improve event delivery for enterprise customers, the team considered dedicated Kafka topics, favoring a private data pipeline for enhanced data privacy. Plans for integrating with external data warehouses like BigQuery involve using Confluent’s connector, though schema complexities remain a concern. The meeting concluded with a focus on building a minimum viable product (MVP) for cloud enterprise customers, ensuring efficient event forwarding and addressing operational challenges like schema migrations.
calls.keywords: Managed Warehouse, Kafka, ClickHouse, Event Forwarding, BigQuery Connector, Materialized Views
